dataset.title: MDT02 - 2ª cobertura (PNOA-LiDAR), Modelo Digital del Terreno 2 m
dataset.why_manual: CNIG direct download requires reCAPTCHA and an interactive licence step; it is not scripted.
instructions: Open each detail_url, accept the licence and download the file into datasets/raw/cnig_mdt02_lanzarote/
Keep the original file name, then run: uv run phase-d && uv run export-web
